sentences.text: This matter was called on for hearing today.

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SURYA KANT HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE J.K.
MAHESHWARI For Petitioner(s) Mr. Sudhanshu S. Choudhari, AOR For Respondent(s) Mr. Sashibhushan P. Adgaonkar, Adv.
Mr. Siddharth Dharmadhikari,, Adv.
Mr. Aaditya Aniruddha Pande, AOR Mr. Bharat Bagla,, Adv.
Mr. Sourav Singh, Adv.
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following O R D E R 1.

The petitioner seeks her enlargement on bail in FIR bearing C.R.No.201/2019,
under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 379, 506, 120-B read with Section 34 IPC,
registered on 07.10.2019 at Police Station Osmanpura, District Aurangabad.

The allegations against the petitioner are that she and accused No.2, Chief Executive Officer and Accountant respectively of the company of the informant, which provide security services, misappropriated a sum of Rs.1.5 crore by forging signature of the informant in respect of bogus salary documents.

The petitioner and other accused Deepshri vs The State Of Maharashtra on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64509970/
1 allegedly prepared fake challans of ESIC Department and Provident Fund Office in respect of employees of the company.

sentences.text: 2. The petitioner was arrested on 18.09.2021 and is in custody for last more than 17 months.
We have been informed that the investigation is over; chargesheet has been filed and the charges have also been framed.
However, the prosecution evidence is yet to commence and the conclusion of trial will, thus, take some time.

3. Taking into consideration the totality of circumstances, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, we are inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
4.
The petitioner is, accordingly, directed to be enlarged on bail subject to her furnishing bail bonds to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
5. The Special Leave Petition stands disposed of accordingly.
6. As a result, pending interlocutory applications also stand disposed of.

(SATISH KUMAR YADAV) (PREETHI T.C.)
 DEPUTY REGISTRAR COURT MASTER (NSH)
